title: Final Check · Weeks 9–12
subtitle: 20 marks · no help · 20 minutes

sections.title: A. Complete the sentences (10 marks)
items: 1) ___ the rain, we went to the beach.
2) I'm saving money ___ order to study abroad.
3) My sister loves maths, ___ I prefer languages.
4) The music is too loud. Can you turn it ___?
5) I'm looking forward ___ (see) you.
6) The more you practise, ___ better you become.
7) This phone is ___ more expensive than mine. (much / very)
8) Trains are not ___ as polluting as planes.
9) I stopped ___ (smoke) last year.
10) Don't forget ___ (send) me the photos.

sections.title: B. Translate into English (5 marks)
items: 1) على الرغم من أنه كان متعبًا، ذهب إلى العمل.
2) أجّلوا الاجتماع إلى يوم الأحد.
3) الحياة في المدينة أغلى بكثير من الحياة في القرية.
4) أندم لأنني لم أتعلم السباحة.
5) صادفت صورة قديمة لجدي.
answers: 1) Although he was tired, he went to work. / Despite being tired, he went to work. / In spite of being tired, he went to work.
2) They put the meeting off (put off the meeting) until Sunday.
3) Life in the city is much (far) more expensive than life in the village.
4) I regret not learning to swim. / I regret not having learnt to swim.
5) I came across an old photo of my grandfather. / I came across an old picture of my grandfather.
